purpose: Joint-driven character performances for child-profile setup, separate shoulder/elbow/hip/neck parts and blink heads.

prompt_set.prompt: Production 2D skeletal-animation texture atlas matching the exact Kai reference identity, polished 3D style and clothes. Transparent square canvas, strict 3x3 row-major grid, one disconnected isolated part per cell, no text or grid. Full smiling head with dreadlocks, ears, neck and open eyes; identical closed-eye head; green T-shirt torso without head arms legs; screen-left upper arm with green sleeve; screen-left forearm with open five-finger palm; screen-right upper arm with sleeve; screen-right forearm with hand; left full blue-jeans leg and green sneaker; right full leg and sneaker. Front-facing, round overlapping joints, each part inside its cell, transparent margins and no background shadows.
prompt_set.refinement: Edit ONLY green clothing shoulder joints. Top-right torso: remove protruding T-shirt sleeves, leave rounded sleeveless openings so articulated sleeves attach without duplication. Middle-left and middle-right upper arms: remove visible brown oval shoulder caps, replace top edge with green sleeve fabric and rounded shoulder ends. Preserve canvas, grid, Kai identity, all expressions, other parts and transparency.
prompt_set.final_refinement: Fill the two dark vertical shoulder slots with matching green fabric. Preserve all cells, identity, expressions and transparency. Solid rounded shoulder silhouette, no protruding sleeves.
